<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of sulphide compositions, respecting the limits (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3 eV/atom, max 3 polymorphs per composition, up to 40 compositions). We'll use the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool to fetch data for a list of common sulphides and store the per‑composition JSON files in a dedicated directory inside the provided workspace. Afterwards we will consolidate all those JSON files into a single dataset and return the path to that consolidated file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "FeS", "FeS2", "CuS", "Cu2S", "ZnS", "PbS", "SnS", "SnS2",
        "MoS2", "WS2", "NiS", "NiS2", "CoS", "CoS2", "MnS", "MnS2",
        "TiS2", "V2S3", "CrS", "CrS2", "Al2S3", "Ga2S3", "In2S3",
        "CdS", "CdS2", "Bi2S3", "Sb2S3", "Ag2S", "AgS", "HgS"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_batch_retrieve_sulphide_polymorphs_trial_9/polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
